properties.name: What worked in flo2's addendum: both discoveries came from the two finders, phrased as jobs
properties.source: flo2 reflow2_feedback.md, 2026-09-19 addendum (F24, F25 and the meta-point)
properties.statement:
Recorded as evidence a regression check can read later, and as the counterweight to the meta-point's complaint. flo2: 'find_tools and the new find_skills are the right fix and they WORKED here: both discoveries in this addendum came from two find_tools calls, phrased as jobs … That is the tool working exactly as designed.'

The two queries, verbatim, both of which found what they needed: 'compose a prompt for a model that turns what a person said into design entries' and 'the slice of the design relevant to this sentence'. Neither names a tool; both are the job in the caller's own words, which is what the held-out corpus exists to keep true.

⭐ WORTH KEEPING BECAUSE IT BOUNDS THE FIX: the catalogue does not need improving. What needs to change is whether anybody is told to ask it.
